ColumnDtype.description: Element type of a table column.

UnitSystem.description: SYSTEM_BASE means per unit on the system base of the model. COMPONENT_BASE means per unit on the own base of each component. NATURAL_UNITS means a physical unit, given in units.

RunStatus.description: Status of a run. RUNNING means a writer is open. The other two values name the end state.

Duration.description: ISO 8601 duration that uses days, hours, and minutes. The minute is the smallest unit: seconds are not permitted. Each part has a maximum of nine digits, so the duration fits in 64-bit milliseconds. Years, months, and weeks are not permitted, because a year and a month have no fixed length.

Filter.description: HDF5 filter: shuffle, or deflate with a level from 1 to 9.

TypeName.description: Name in upper camel case. It starts with an upper case letter.

Meta.description: Optional text that separates datasets with the same entry type and component type. It has no double underscore and no slash, because the HDF5 path uses both as separators.

Timestamp.description: Naive local datetime with no zone or offset.

PathName.description: One path segment. It is not empty, not . or .., and has no slash or backslash.

AxisGroup.description: HDF5 group path that holds the axis data.

UnitSystemRule.description: A SYSTEM_BASE or COMPONENT_BASE value has units pu. A NATURAL_UNITS value has a physical unit, not pu.

SnakeName.description: Lower snake case name from the vocabulary of a domain.
